persons.name: Dharmendrasiṃha
persons.evidence: liṣiṭa karmmacārya dhamendrasiṁha pūtra … deva nihmasyana coyā jula

notes: The colophon is undated and names no place. 'liṣiṭa … nihmasyana coyā jula' (Newari: 'written … the two of them wrote it') says the copy was made jointly by Karmācārya 'Dhamendrasiṃha' (probably for Dharmendrasiṃha) and his son. Only the ending of the son's name, '…deva', survives; the rest is lost in a lacuna marked by the cataloguer. The colophon gives karmācārya only for the father, though the son probably shared it. It closes with the stock scribe's disclaimer (yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ likhitaṃ mayā…: 'I copied it as I found it; whether correct or not, the fault is not mine').
